Seller Guidelines

Welcome to Sham Marianas F.Z.C

Congratulations on joining Sham Marianas F.Z.C, as a valued contributor. This comprehensive guide outlines our platform standards, submission processes, and best practices to ensure your success. Please read these guidelines thoroughly before submitting any assets.

Account Access & Login Procedures

New Contributor Registration

  • Visit www.shammarianas/templates.com
  • Click the Login button
  • Complete the registration form with accurate details
  • Verify your email address through the confirmation link
  • Set up your secure password and profile information
  • Waiting for Sham Marianas F.Z.C, approval

Existing Contributor Login

  • Navigate to www.shammarianas.com/login
  • Enter your registered email address and password
  • Access your personalized Contributor Dashboard
  • For password reset, use the "Forgot Password" feature

Asset Submission Standards

Approval Criteria

Assets meeting the following standards will be approved:

A. Technical Specifications:
  • Thumbnail size: 705x472px, 300 DPI, RGB color mode
  • Upload file: file size maximum 10 mb
B. Content Quality Requirements:
  • Original content created by you
  • Professional composition and framing
  • Proper lighting and exposure
  • Sharp focus with no visible noise or artifacts
  • Commercial viability and market relevance
C. Metadata Requirements:
  • Titles (15 words maximum)
  • Comprehensive descriptions (50-200 words)
  • Relevant keywords (5-15 per asset)
  • Accurate categorization
  • Proper tagging for search optimization
D. Legal Compliance:
  • All necessary model/property releases
  • No trademarked or copyrighted material
  • Appropriate content for a general audience
  • Accurate representation of subject matter

Common Reasons for Rejection

1. Quality Issues

  • Poor technical execution (blurry, pixelated, or distorted media)
  • Inadequate lighting or improper exposure
  • Unprofessional composition or framing
  • Visible artifacts, noise, or compression issues

2. Content Problems

  • Lack of commercial appeal or market relevance
  • Inappropriate or sensitive content without proper disclosure
  • Misleading or inaccurate representations
  • Overly generic or commonplace subjects

3. Legal & Copyright Violations

  • Unauthorized use of copyrighted material
  • Missing model/property releases for recognizable elements
  • Trademark infringement
  • Privacy violations or unauthorized surveillance content

4. Technical Non-Compliance

  • Incorrect file formats or sizes
  • Corrupted or incomplete files
  • Watermarked or branded content
  • Improper metadata or incomplete information

5. Policy Violations

  • Spam or duplicate submissions
  • Attempts to manipulate search rankings
  • Violation of community standards
  • Previously rejected content resubmitted without improvements

Review Process & Timeline

Submission Workflow:

  • Initial Upload: Asset enters review queue
  • Technical Review: 24-48 hours for format verification
  • Quality Assessment: 3-5 business days for content evaluation
  • Final Decision: Notification via email and dashboard update

Status Definitions:

  • Approved: Asset published to the marketplace, available for licensing
  • Rejected: Detailed feedback provided with improvement suggestions
  • Pending: Additional information or clarification required

Best Practices for Success

1. Profile Development

  • Focus on your areas of expertise
  • Develop a consistent style and aesthetic
  • Balance evergreen content with trending topics

2. Quality Optimization

  • Invest in proper equipment and software
  • Master editing and post-production techniques
  • Stay current with technical standards
  • Regularly review and update older content

3. Strategic Submission

  • Research market trends and demands
  • Analyze successful contributors in your niche
  • Submit during optimal times (avoid holiday periods)
  • Maintain a consistent upload schedule

4. Community Engagement

  • Participate in contributor forums
  • Respond promptly to reviewer feedback
  • Collaborate with other contributors
  • Stay informed about platform updates

Support & Resources

Contact Information:

  • Contributor Support: info@shammarianas.com
  • Technical Issues: support@shammarianas.com

Response Times:

  • General inquiries: 24-48 business hours
  • Technical support: 48-72 business hours
  • Urgent matters: Mark as "URGENT" in the subject line

Performance Optimization

30-Day Success Roadmap:

  • Week 1-2: Focus on quality over quantity; submit 5-10 exceptional assets
  • Week 3-4: Analyze performance metrics; refine your approach
  • Month 2: Expand portfolio based on successful patterns
  • Ongoing: Regular portfolio review and content refresh

Key Performance Indicators:

  • Approval rate (target: 85%+)
  • Download-to-submission ratio
  • Portfolio growth consistency

Policy Compliance & Updates

Sham Marianas F.Z.C, reserves the right to:

  • Update these guidelines without prior notice
  • Adjust review standards based on market demands
  • Modify commission structures with a 30-day notice
  • Terminate accounts violating platform policies

Contributors are responsible for:

  • Regularly reviewing updated guidelines
  • Maintaining accurate account information
  • Complying with all applicable laws and regulations
  • Securing their login credentials

Frequently Asked Questions

Q1: What is the typical review timeframe?

Most assets are reviewed within 2-7 business days. During peak periods, reviews may take up to 10 business days.

Q2: Can I appeal a rejection decision?

Yes, you may request reconsideration through the contributor portal if you believe the decision was incorrect or have made substantial improvements.

Q3: What commission structure does Sham Marianas F.Z.C offer?

Commission rates range from 40% to 60% based on contributor tier, content exclusivity, and sales performance. Detailed rates are available in your dashboard.

Q5: When are payments processed?

Payments are issued monthly for earnings exceeding $50. Payments are processed via Stripe or Skill, based on your preference.

Q6: Can I submit similar variations of the same asset?

Minor variations are acceptable if each provides a distinct value. Blatant duplicates will be rejected.
